candidate_memories.content: [Project: Orion] Key generation must use ED25519 per the Orion security specification; RSA is explicitly prohibited for new Orion keys.

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Argus] ED25519 is not FIPS-approved for Argus; all Argus cryptographic operations must use NIST-approved algorithms only.
